questions.q: Suppose $x_1, x_2, x_3, \dots, x_{100}$ are in arithmetic progression such that $x_5 = -4$ and $2x_6 + 2x_9 = x_{11} + x_{13}$. Then, $x_{100}$ equals
questions.explain: Let $a$ be the first term and $d$ the common difference. $x_5 = a + 4d = -4$. Also, $2(a + 5d) + 2(a + 8d) = (a + 10d) + (a + 12d) \implies 2a + 10d + 2a + 16d = 2a + 22d \implies 4a + 26d = 2a + 22d \implies 2a + 4d = 0 \implies a = -2d$. Substitute in $a + 4d = -4 \implies -2d + 4d = -4 \implies 2d = -4 \implies d = -2$. Then $a = 4$. $x_{100} = a + 99d = 4 + 99(-2) = 4 - 198 = -194$.
